title: Modern Craft
description: A hardcore server. Although it seemed like hardcore, but you can respawn if you died.  Basic gameplay: building, redstone machines.
body:
## A hardcore server. Although it seemed like hardcore, but **you can respawn if you died**.

## Basic gameplay: **building**, **redstone machines**.

[You can look for newer IP that have quicker connection in our wikipage: https://modern-craft.fandom.com/zh/wiki/%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80](https://modern-craft.fandom.com/zh/wiki/%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80)

Doamin1:mdc-mc.cc.cd
Doamin2:d.mdc-mc.cc.cd

You can build anything you want to build,like a city, a town, a village or improving existing cities.(In addition to taboo architecture)

[Our Wikipage: https://modern-craft.fandom.com/zh/wiki/](https://modern-craft.fandom.com/zh/wiki/)

## Tips:

·When cutting trees or mining, pressing Shift can enable chain mining.

·Use smithing table to upgrade tools and armor from iron to diamond(swords can upgrade stone or iron to diamond) saving the enchantments.

·You can see your tool or armor stats like craft date, the player who crafted/looted, dameage have done, etc.

You can **join server QQ group (group ID:1016992834)** or view server website (under construction, temporarily closed) to learn more.

The server will **automatically backup**.

Server opening date: 2023-08

Description update time:2026-2-23
